relationships.subject: PVN oxytocin neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: PVN OXT neurons exert a descending facilitatory effect on GABAergic neurons in the TNC via OXT release, thereby ameliorating pain sensitization in chronic migraine.

relationships.subject: PVN oxytocin neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: HPLC analysis showed that, compared with the negative control group, the model control group and the atosiban group, GABA level of TNC in the CNO activated model group increased

key_findings: Anterograde tracing showed PVN OXT neurons project to TNC GABAergic neurons.
Chemogenetic activation of PVN OXT neurons raised TNC GABA and relieved periorbital allodynia in NTG chronic migraine mice, effects reversed by intra-TNC atosiban.
